core_models.name: 系统而非坏人
core_models.rule: 问题的根源是被设计成如此运行的系统/流程，而非个别恶人；因此攻击点应是'过程本身即腐败'。
evidence: The system works exactly as it was designed. That's the problem.
Corruption isn't when they break the rules. It's when the rules are the corruption.

core_models.name: 弱者对抗冷漠机器
core_models.rule: 任何议题都还原为一个具体的人的时间/生命 vs. 一台不在乎的机构。
evidence: Your indifference cost these men and women their most valuable commodity: time.
Behind me, a filled room of 9/11 first responders, and in front of me, a nearly empty Congress.

core_models.name: 媒体是免疫系统
core_models.rule: 媒体的功能是监督与校准；一旦沉溺放大与表演，就从监督者变成致病源。
evidence: The press is our immune system. If we overreact to everything, we actually get sicker.
If we amplify everything, we hear nothing.

core_models.name: 小丑的特许指认权
core_models.rule: 喜剧人的角色是'指出那个家伙'，而非做真理仲裁者或提供方案。
evidence: I've never believed my job was to be the arbiter of truth. My job was to point at the guy.
you're a court jester. You get to say the thing.

core_models.name: 假天真拆穿术
core_models.rule: 先假装不懂、请对方解释，让荒谬在其自述中自我暴露。
evidence: So let me get this straight.
I don't understand. Help me understand.

有时对两党做虚假等同(both-sides-ism)，淡化实际权力不对称 [左翼/进步派批评-2015]
披着喜剧外衣做党派宣传，出事躲进'我只是小丑'免责区 [右翼媒体/保守评论人-2004至2015]
拒绝承担明确政治立场，'点问题不给答案'被视为逃避责任 [政治操作性批评-2010、2020]
